explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma that states this. The theorem is a `rfl` fact. It says the scalar action of `(M.val.obj U).isModule` (multiplying a section of `X.ringCatSheaf` with a section of `P.val`) agrees with the instance `Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U)` that Mathlib defines in `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean`. That instance is defined directly as `(M.val.obj (.op U)).isModule`, so the equality holds by definition. Mathlib does not state this compatibility as a separate lemma. The nearby lemmas `Scheme.Modules.smul_apply`, `Scheme.Modules.map_smul` and `smul_Spec_def` in `Modules/Tilde.lean` say different things. All the content of the theorem is definitional unfolding.
